name: border-bottom
description: A solid bottom border below dotted cell guides.
useCase: Apply a bottom border to the selected cells.
misuse: The dotted points are alignment guides; name the border action on its control.

16.reason: Round guide points mark the cell corners; continuous lines show the selected borders inside the shared square frame.

24.reason: Evenly spaced guide points retain the grid around the active border lines, with matched margins on every side.
